response.justification: Despite extensive experience as a senior software developer, the candidate lacks junior-level alignment: Java is only listed as a skill without project context, German proficiency is basic (not fluent), and the resume reflects senior/lead roles inconsistent with an entry-level position, raising concerns about role fit and salary expectations.
strengths: Extensive full-stack experience across multiple languages and platforms
Strong open-source contributions and technical communication through workshops
Demonstrated agile practices (TDD, CI/CD) and cloud infrastructure exposure
concerns: German language proficiency is only basic, but required fluently for client work
Resume shows senior-level roles for over a decade, not entry-level candidate profile
Java experience is listed but not demonstrated in any project context
